Key_Symptoms: No symptoms present
Visible_Skin_Signs: Smooth, evenly pigmented skin with intact barrier, no lesions, rash, or abnormal texture
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: None
Risk_Factors: None

Key_Symptoms: Symmetric skin rash in sun-exposed areas, diarrhea, confusion, burning skin sensation
Visible_Skin_Signs: Symmetric, well-demarcated, reddish-brown scaly rash on sun-exposed skin (classic pellagra dermatitis)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Classic triad: dermatitis, diarrhea, dementia; glossitis, fatigue, weight loss
Risk_Factors: Corn-based diet without niacin fortification, alcoholism, carcinoid syndrome, isoniazid therapy, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Skin burning/stinging after sun exposure, redness, itching in exposed areas
Visible_Skin_Signs: Erythema and scaling confined to sun-exposed skin (face, neck, forearms, hands), sharply demarcated from covered skin
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Photosensitivity, fatigue, diarrhea in advanced stages
Risk_Factors: Chronic niacin-poor diet, alcoholism, prolonged sun exposure combined with deficiency, certain medications

Key_Symptoms: Darkened skin patches, mild itching, rough texture
Visible_Skin_Signs: Diffuse or patchy hyperpigmentation, typically in sun-exposed or previously inflamed areas, thickened/rough skin
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Chronic malnutrition signs, fatigue, glossitis
Risk_Factors: Longstanding untreated niacin deficiency, chronic alcoholism, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Ring-like rash around neck, burning/itching sensation in affected band
Visible_Skin_Signs: Characteristic band-like pigmented, scaly dermatitis encircling the neck (Casal's necklace) - hallmark sign of pellagra
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, dementia/confusion, glossitis, weight loss (classic pellagra features)
Risk_Factors: Severe chronic niacin deficiency, corn-dependent diet, alcoholism

Key_Symptoms: Rash and thickening on hands resembling a glove pattern, burning sensation
Visible_Skin_Signs: Well-demarcated scaly, hyperpigmented dermatitis covering the hands in a glove-like distribution
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, mental confusion, glossitis, fatigue
Risk_Factors: Severe chronic niacin deficiency, sun-exposed occupational hand use, alcoholism

Key_Symptoms: Rash and thickening on feet/lower legs resembling a boot pattern, burning sensation
Visible_Skin_Signs: Well-demarcated scaly, hyperpigmented dermatitis covering the feet and lower legs in a boot-like distribution
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, mental confusion, glossitis, fatigue
Risk_Factors: Severe chronic niacin deficiency, barefoot sun exposure, alcoholism

Key_Symptoms: Small red/purple spots around hair follicles, easy bruising, joint pain
Visible_Skin_Signs: Perifollicular hemorrhages (small bleeding spots surrounding hair follicles), often with corkscrew hairs nearby
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scurvy symptoms: bleeding gums, fatigue, poor wound healing
Risk_Factors: Severe dietary restriction, poor fruit/vegetable intake, alcoholism, smoking, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Tiny red/purple spots on skin, easy bruising, fatigue
Visible_Skin_Signs: Pinpoint, non-blanching red/purple petechial spots, often on lower legs
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Bleeding gums, joint pain, fatigue, poor wound healing
Risk_Factors: Severe Vitamin C deficient diet, alcoholism, smoking, malabsorption disorders

Key_Symptoms: Large bruise-like patches, tenderness, easy bruising with minor trauma
Visible_Skin_Signs: Large areas of bluish-purple skin discoloration (bruising) from minor trauma due to capillary fragility
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Bleeding gums, joint swelling/pain, fatigue, anemia
Risk_Factors: Severe Vitamin C deficient diet, alcoholism, elderly age, malabsorption disorders

Key_Symptoms: Rough bumpy skin texture, dryness, small raised bumps on arms/thighs
Visible_Skin_Signs: Keratotic follicular papules giving a 'goosebump'-like rough texture, often with surrounding perifollicular hemorrhage
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, bleeding gums, joint pain, poor wound healing
Risk_Factors: Severe Vitamin C deficient diet, alcoholism, smoking, malabsorption disorders

Key_Symptoms: Dry, rough skin, itching, flaking especially on arms and legs
Visible_Skin_Signs: Diffuse dry, scaly skin (xerosis), rough texture, loss of normal skin sheen
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Night blindness, poor wound healing, frequent infections, dry eyes
Risk_Factors: Vitamin A deficient diet, fat malabsorption, alcoholism, liver disease

Key_Symptoms: Rough bumpy skin texture resembling 'goosebumps,' dryness, itching
Visible_Skin_Signs: Keratotic plugging of hair follicles producing a rough, 'toad skin' (phrynoderma) texture, typically on extensor surfaces
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Night blindness, dry eyes, reduced immunity, poor wound healing
Risk_Factors: Chronic Vitamin A deficient diet, fat malabsorption disorders, chronic liver disease

Key_Symptoms: Red scaly rash around mouth, eyes, and nose, itching, discomfort
Visible_Skin_Signs: Well-demarcated erythematous, scaly, sometimes erosive plaques around mouth, eyes, and nose
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, hair loss, poor wound healing, altered taste, impaired immunity
Risk_Factors: Malabsorption syndromes, vegetarian/vegan diet, chronic diarrhea, alcoholism, pregnancy, infants with acrodermatitis enteropathica

Key_Symptoms: Red scaly rash on hands, feet, fingers and toes, cracking, discomfort
Visible_Skin_Signs: Erythematous, scaly, sometimes vesiculobullous plaques on acral surfaces (hands, feet, digits), skin fissuring
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, hair loss, poor wound healing, altered taste, growth retardation in children
Risk_Factors: Malabsorption syndromes, low dietary zinc intake, chronic illness, acrodermatitis enteropathica (genetic form)

Key_Symptoms: Redness, irritation, and scaling in perianal region, discomfort
Visible_Skin_Signs: Erythematous, scaly, sometimes erosive plaques in the perianal/perineal area
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, poor wound healing, hair loss, impaired immunity
Risk_Factors: Chronic zinc deficiency, malabsorption, infants with acrodermatitis enteropathica, prolonged diaper use in deficient infants

Key_Symptoms: Thick scaly red plaques resembling psoriasis, itching, discomfort
Visible_Skin_Signs: Well-demarcated, thick, scaly erythematous plaques mimicking psoriasis, typically at acral and periorificial sites
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, hair loss, poor wound healing, altered taste, impaired immunity
Risk_Factors: Chronic zinc deficiency, malabsorption, alcoholism, vegetarian/vegan diet

Key_Symptoms: Fluid-filled blisters, skin fragility, pain, itching
Visible_Skin_Signs: Vesicles and bullae (fluid-filled blisters) often at acral and periorificial sites, may rupture leaving erosions
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Diarrhea, poor wound healing, hair loss, growth retardation in children, impaired immunity
Risk_Factors: Severe acute zinc deficiency, acrodermatitis enteropathica, malabsorption, parenteral nutrition without adequate zinc

Key_Symptoms: Red scaly rash around mouth, eyes, and nose, mild itching
Visible_Skin_Signs: Erythematous, scaly plaques distributed around the mouth, eyes, and nasal area
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Hair loss (alopecia), brittle nails, fatigue, numbness/tingling in extremities
Risk_Factors: Raw egg white consumption (avidin), prolonged antibiotic/anticonvulsant use, pregnancy, biotinidase deficiency

Key_Symptoms: Redness and irritation in skin folds (armpits, groin), itching, discomfort
Visible_Skin_Signs: Erythematous, moist, sometimes macerated plaques in skin fold areas (intertriginous zones)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Hair loss, brittle nails, fatigue, mild depression
Risk_Factors: Prolonged raw egg white intake, certain medications, malabsorption, genetic biotinidase deficiency

Key_Symptoms: Peeling skin resembling flaking paint, dark patches, soreness in affected areas
Visible_Skin_Signs: Hyperpigmented plaques that peel and flake in a 'flaky paint' pattern, often over pressure points and lower extremities, revealing pale skin underneath
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Edema (kwashiorkor), muscle wasting, growth failure, lethargy, hair depigmentation
Risk_Factors: Severe protein deficiency (kwashiorkor), poverty, famine conditions, chronic undernutrition in children

Key_Symptoms: Dry, thin, easily damaged skin, slow wound healing, fatigue
Visible_Skin_Signs: Dry, thin, atrophic-appearing skin that tears or breaks down easily, reduced skin turgor
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Muscle wasting, weight loss, lethargy, poor wound healing, immune suppression
Risk_Factors: Chronic caloric/protein restriction, chronic illness, poverty, eating disorders, elderly malnutrition

Key_Symptoms: Darkened skin patches with peeling, soreness, dryness
Visible_Skin_Signs: Hyperpigmented areas with surface desquamation (scaling/peeling), typically over friction or pressure-prone areas
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Edema, muscle wasting, growth retardation, lethargy, hair changes
Risk_Factors: Severe chronic protein-energy malnutrition, poverty, famine conditions, chronic illness in children
